children: The industrial confidence indicator in Slovakia fell by 17 points to -15 in August 2026, reversing from 2.0 in the previous month and reaching its lowest level since June 2023.
Assessments deteriorated further for current order levels (-17 vs -14) and current export orders (-18 vs -16), while the assessment of the trend in industrial production turned negative (-7 vs 32).
At the same time, expectations eased for the trend in industrial production (15 vs 16) and product prices (8 vs 10).
In contrast, current stocks of finished products increased (21 vs 12).
Meanwhile, the employment outlook also weakened, easing to 5 in August from 7 in the previous month, pointing to a further deterioration in overall industrial sentiment.

title: Slovakia Business Mood Drops to Lowest Since 2023
